units.CD2001-matadi: Matadi, capital of Kongo-Central province and the DRC's main seaport, lies far from the eastern conflict zones and no armed group holds territory in the city. Day-to-day order across its communes (Matadi, Mvuzi, Nzanza) and health-area neighbourhoods is kept by the Congolese National Police (PNC), with FARDC, naval and port-security elements also present. Security problems are urban crime (kuluna-type banditry) and periodic political unrest linked historically to the Bundu dia Kongo movement (notably 2017-2020), neither of which amounts to territorial control. The small 'Militaire' health area (Camp Redjaf military camp) is assessed as FARDC-run. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence.
